maria (eng-release): Kicking off the region-splitter rollout. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, 10% -> 50% -> full. Holdpoints at EU 10% and APAC 10%. Please confirm capacity checks and pin rules.

leo (eng-sre): @maria noted. Running quick capacity probe now. Checking GPU pool headroom and warm-pool sizes.

deploy-bot: Automated checklist: canary deploy started in US at 2024-11-12T14:09:03Z. Canary instances: 4. Smoke tests queued.

anya (eng-runtime): US canary smoke passed 3/3 (latency, error-rate, token-ops). Observability looks green. Suggest we keep EU hold at 10% until warm pools scale. :thumbsup:

leo (eng-sre): Capacity probe results: US reserved GPU pool usage after canary ramp is 62% (headroom 38%). EU reserved pool currently at 55% before traffic. APAC at 48%. Warm pool targets set to 120% for EU warmup.

maria (eng-release): Good. Pinning model version for rollout: v3.4.1-rt. Command: `/pin-release v3.4.1-rt --regions us,eu,apac`

kofi (product-ops): Quick reminder: release notes already posted to #release-notes and customers with Dedicated are notified. No enterprise hold requests outstanding.

leo (eng-sre): Recommend throttle rules: EU slice ramp from 10% -> 30% over 20m, soak 10m, then 50% after green. APAC start to 10% after EU passes soak. Rollback trigger: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR median latency > 600ms for 3m.

maria (eng-release): Ack. Adding these to the deploybot policy.

deploy-bot: Canary -> US->EU staged action queued. Next automated message on EU canary start. Logs: `deploybot://jobs/5109876543/us-canary`

anya (eng-runtime): Also enabling KV prefix caching for EU canary which should reduce tail latency on hot prompts. Patch applied to the runtime config: `kv_cache.enabled = true`

leo (eng-sre): One more: thermal headroom check for EU zone shows two machines near 90% GPU temp; we've shifted a node out of the warm pool to avoid hot stacking. Will monitor.

maria (eng-release): EU canary go-ahead in T+12m. @leo please watch autoscaler and signal green/hold via this thread. If we need immediate rollback, use `/rollback v3.4.1-rt --region eu` and call the oncall phone tree.

leo (eng-sre): Copy. I'll post a green/hold within the holdpoint window.

deploy-bot: EU canary started at 2024-11-12T14:22:07Z. Smoke tests running.

anya (eng-runtime): EU smoke: latency median 210ms, p95 480ms, errors 0.25%. All good so far.

maria (eng-release): Green from me. Ramp EU to 30% now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 30% initiated. Expected time to target ~8m. Monitoring policy: rollback triggers as posted.

leo (eng-sre): Watching metrics. If p95 crosses 650ms I'll flip a hold. Also prepping rollback patch with previous model variant pinned as fallback. Fallback command saved: `deploybot fallback --variant v3.3.9-quant --region eu`

kofi (product-ops): FYI support queue has a couple of customers in EU on Dedicated; I'll ping them about the ramp.

maria (eng-release): If EU soak stays green for 15m, we schedule APAC canary to 10%. Otherwise hold and backfill warm pool.

leo (eng-sre): Noted. Current runbook check: all manual gates are in ops runbook page.

maria (eng-release): Thanks team. Will post final deploy note when APAC starts. Keep updates short here (green/hold/rollback).

leo (eng-sre): green
